newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exported 1.1 mln tns soybeans in June - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exported 1.1 mln tns soybeans in June - SGS.

text.p: Brazil exported 1.11 million tonnes of soybeans in June, down 38.3 percent from May, inspection company SGS do Brasil said.
Exports of soymeal rose slightly to 1.22 million tonnes while soyoil exports grew 8.6 percent month-on-month to 197,600 tonnes, SGS said. There were no comparisons with 1996.
In the first half of the year, Brazil exported 4.88 million tonnes of soybeans, up 99.5 percent on the first semester of 1996.
Soymeal exports fell 6.8 percent to 4.92 million tonnes in the first six months of the year, while soyoil loading rose 5.2 percent to 643,500, SGS said.
Paranagua port remained the main soy shipper with 2.93 million tonnes soybeans, 2.73 million tonnes soymeal and 386,100 tonnes soyoil loaded between January and June.
Rio Grande ranked second with 792,200 tonnes soybeans, 945,500 tonnes soymeal and 214,400 tonnes soyoil. Sao Francisco was third with 884,300 tonnes soymeal and 43,000 tonnes soyoil.
